candidate_selection: all complete basic, extended, and blur Windows Software FLOAT EXR before/effect pairs

required_contract.working_space: must be recorded exactly; no inferred default
required_contract.linear_blending: must be recorded exactly; no inferred default
required_contract.input: the case-specific Windows before-effects EXR, imported without conversion

acceptance.ae_exact_requires: raw float channel equality against the corresponding Windows effect EXR after proving identical input and parameter bindings
acceptance.comparison: compare all pixels and RGBA channels as raw IEEE-754 FLOAT32 words from the float-preserving files; record max absolute error, nonzero count, and NaN/Inf policy for both control and effect
acceptance.control_gate: Windows before-effects EXR equals Mac same-context no-effect EXR before effect exactness is considered
acceptance.effect_gate: Windows effect EXR equals Mac same-context effect-on EXR
acceptance.missing_binding_action: fail closed and list the missing field; do not substitute a nearby case or infer settings

stop_lines: do not claim AE exact from PNG, 16bpc, or diagnostic-only evidence
fail if any case is missing input identity, parameters, provenance, plugin hash, or raw float output
fail if output directory is reused
fail if same-context no-effect control is missing or mismatched
fail if any raw FLOAT32 word differs, including NaN/Inf policy violations
fail if the Mac output is not 32bpc Software EXR
